product: JPL GRACE and GRACE-FO Mascon Ocean, Ice, and Hydrology Equivalent Water Height Coastal Resolution Improvement (CRI) Filtered Release 06.3 Version 04
attribution: D. N. Wiese, D.-N. Yuan, C. Boening, F. W. Landerer, M. M. Watkins. 2023. JPL GRACE and GRACE-FO Mascon Ocean, Ice, and Hydrology Equivalent Water Height CRI Filtered RL06.3Mv04. PO.DAAC. https://doi.org/10.5067/TEMSC-3JC634
method: Each res-6 cell whose centre lies in the region box takes the value of the grid pixel containing its centre (nearest-pixel sampling, as for the NASA POWER layers); neighbouring cells repeat values. JPL RL06.3 CRI mascon liquid-water-equivalent thickness × the CRI land scale factor, land mask applied (ocean absent). Anomaly relative to the 2004.0-2009.999 mean. 2024 months present: 2024-01-16, 2024-02-15, 2024-03-16, 2024-04-16, 2024-05-16, 2024-06-16, 2024-07-16, 2024-08-16, 2024-09-16, 2024-10-16, 2024-11-16, 2024-12-16.
sampling: nearest grid pixel at each cell centre
